bbq-redskapsset-for-grillen.title: BBQ Tool Set – 3, 5 or 9 Pieces
bbq-redskapsset-for-grillen.descriptionHtml:
Everything you need for a cracking night at the BBQ!
With our BBQ tool set you get practical, hard-wearing stainless steel BBQ tools, packed in a handy carry case that makes them easy to store and take along. Perfect for beginners and seasoned BBQ masters alike.

Choose between three different sets to suit how you barbecue:

3 Pieces – To Go Set
The small but mighty set for picnics, camping and quick BBQ sessions. Includes the essential tools so you can barbecue wherever you are.

5 Pieces – The BBQ Amateur
A more complete set for those who like to fire up the BBQ a bit more often. More tools mean better control, making your barbecuing easier and a lot more fun.

9 Pieces – The BBQ Master
The ultimate set for the BBQ fanatic! You get every tool you need to master the barbecue, whether you're cooking meat, fish, veggies or sides.

Features:

  • Made from durable stainless steel

  • Ergonomic handles for a secure grip

  • Comes in a practical storage case

  • Three different sets to choose from (3, 5 or 9 pieces)

  • The perfect gift for BBQ lovers

Whether you're a weekend BBQer or a true BBQ master, there's a set here with your name on it!

6-pack-knivset.title: 6-Piece Knife Set – Premium Stainless Steel Kitchen Knives with Damascus-Inspired Design
6-pack-knivset.descriptionHtml:
Take your kitchen to the next level with a complete knife set that combines function, sharpness and elegance.
The knives are made from hard-wearing 7CR17 stainless steel and feature a beautiful Damascus-inspired pattern that makes every knife a stylish detail in your kitchen.

Each knife is carefully sharpened to a razor-sharp edge that handles everyday cooking and special occasions alike. The ergonomic wood-look handles sit comfortably in the hand and give a secure grip, even through longer cooking sessions.

The set includes:

  • Chef's knife – the all-rounder for most tasks

  • Bread knife – serrated edge for hard crusts and soft centres

  • Cleaver – perfect for vegetables and larger ingredients

  • Santoku knife – Japanese-inspired knife for precision work

  • Utility knife – a handy knife for everyday use

  • Paring knife – a small knife for fruit, vegetables and detail work

Features:

  • 6 knives in premium 7CR17 stainless steel

  • Laser-engraved Damascus-inspired pattern

  • Extremely sharp blades for effortless cutting

  • Ergonomic handles with a comfortable grip

  • Hardness: 58 Rockwell – durable and hard-wearing

  • A complete set for every job in the kitchen

An exclusive knife set for those who want both style and performance in the kitchen – just as at home on a weeknight as at a dinner party.
